title: A topos for étale-finite Heyting algebras
summary: A longstanding open problem is whether every Heyting algebra is the lattice of truth values (i.e., of subterminal objects) of some elementary topos. A positive answer is known for complete Heyting algebras (i.e., locales) via sheaves, and for Boolean algebras via a construction due to Peter Freyd. We extend Freyd's construction to all étale-finite Heyting algebras, in the sense of Evgeny Kuznetsov.
